card.text: WASP-11 b was found in 2008 by SuperWASP as it crossed its star.

sources.label: Wikipedia, "WASP-11b"
sources.quote: WASP-11b/HAT-P-10b or WASP-11Ab/HAT-P-10Ab is an extrasolar planet discovered in 2008.

introduction.text: It is the only planet known around WASP-11. Its orbit and size follow Stassun et al. 2017's fit, the archive's default.

sources.label: Wikipedia, "WASP-11b"
sources.quote: The discovery was announced by press release by the SuperWASP project in April 2008 along with planets WASP-6b through to WASP-15b, however at this stage more data was needed to confirm the parameters of the planets and the coordinates were not given.
